newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST- London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST- London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain-based Citibank plans to open offices in Abu Dhabi and Malaysia.
- Jordan's labour minister said his country does not intend to send workers to Israel, and said he had no intention of signing a labour agreement with Tel Aviv.
- The Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development extended a $6.5 million loan to Syria.
- Lebanon is to host a banking and economic conference in November to review Arab investors' role in reconstruction.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton has telephoned Saudi King Fahd. U.S. Defence Secretary Perry is due in Saudi Arabia on Sunday evening for talks with Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan.
- The emirate of Abu Dhabi completes steps to set up an Islamic bank, intends to form a hotel company.
- OPEC secretary general said increased oil demand and tension in the Middle East caused oil price rises.
